more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 172.820, checked in 2026.
more_info.uses: Specified US uses include food tablets, vitamin or mineral preparations and coatings on sodium nitrite. The provision excludes milk and preparations intended for addition to milk.
more_info.origin: A synthetic polymer formed from ethylene oxide and water. The US provision covers mean molecular weights from 200 to 9,500.
more_info.overview: Polyethylene glycol is a synthetic polymer used as a coating, binder or dispersing ingredient in specified food preparations. The permitted molecular-weight range includes PEG 8000.
